                  </jats:sub>In<jats:sub>
                     <jats:italic>x</jats:italic>
                  </jats:sub>As agree well with experimental data by EXAFS. The change in bond lengths for Ga<jats:sub>0.5</jats:sub>In<jats:sub>0.5</jats:sub>As is only 21%, compared with that calculated using the virtual-crystal approximation approach.
